name: io.github.KevinChu1110/driftnet
title: driftnet
description: A local catalogue of the links your chats share: search, save and file them. Any model, or none.

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where settings and the catalogue live (default ~/.driftnet)

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: anthropic, openai, gemini, bedrock, vertex, claude-cli or gemini-cli; empty for no summaries

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for that provider (gemini also reads GEMINI_API_KEY; for vertex it may be a raw access token)

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the openai provider (Ollama, OpenRouter, Gemini…)

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_LLM_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Region for the bedrock provider (or AWS_REGION) and the vertex provider (default us-central1)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: bedrock provider: AWS access key ID (with AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for temporary credentials)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: bedrock provider: AWS secret access key

environmentVariables.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
environmentVariables.description: bedrock provider: a Bedrock API key, used instead of the AWS keys

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: vertex provider: path to a service-account JSON key file (or DRIFTNET_VERTEX_CREDENTIALS)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: vertex provider: Google Cloud project id (optional when the key file names one)

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_JUDGE
environmentVariables.description: Who files each link before the model: jev, rules (free, no model), llm, heuristic, off, or a plugin's judge name

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_JUDGE_RULES
environmentVariables.description: Path to a rules file for the rules judge, one 'pattern -> folder' per line

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language summaries are written in (default English)

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTNET_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Name recorded for this agent's saves and votes (default local)
